description: Review a change set like an experienced teammate. Surfaces the highest-risk issues first — correctness, regressions, security, data integrity — before style or nits. Trigger on "review my changes", "review this diff", "review this PR", "can you look over what I changed", or "sanity check this before I push". This is the generalist reviewer: it flags auth, migration, query, API-shape, UI and observability issues it notices but does not go deep. For dedicated depth, use review-auth, review-migration, check-query-safety, review-api, review-ui or review-observability.
